p9_b0.ocr: In the Asia-Pacific region, LyondellBasell's Specialty Chemical Margins exhibit varying trends across categories from 2019 to 2023, with Polymers showing a 5-Year CAGR of 5.2% in 2019, declining to 4.8% in 2020, increasing to 6.1% in 2021, then to 5.5% in 2022, and finally settling at 4.9% in 2023. Additives started at 3.4% in 2019, decreased to 3.0% in 2020, rose to 3.8% in 2021, dipped to 3.6% in 2022, and closed at 3.2% in 2023.

p9_b1.ocr: Surfactants began at 2.8% in 2019, fell to 2.5% in 2020, climbed to 3.0% in 2021, slightly decreased to 2.9% in 2022, and ended at 2.7% in 2023. Solvents recorded 4.0% in 2019, decreased to 3.7% in 2020, increased to 4.4% in 2021, and reached 4.1% in 2022.
